title: Office Order No. A.1307/1979 dated 27/02/2026, regarding assignment of charge of the post of Registrar (Legal, Law & Inquiry)
text:
KEY LINES:
from 01/03/2026.

FULL TEXT:
OFFICE ORDER
No. A.1307/1979
The Honourable Chief Justice, High Court of Gujarat, Anmedabad has been
pleased to assign Mr. Prashant Jain, Registrar (Recruitment), High Court of
Gujarat, Ahmedabad, the additional charge of the post of Registrar (Legal, Law &
inquiry), High Court of Gujarat, Anmedabad over and above his duties, with effect
from 01/03/2026.
High Court of Gujarat, at Sola,
Ahmedabad - 380 060.
